definitions.explanation: The limbs of a bird or the parts of an aircraft that enable flight.
Used metaphorically to represent freedom, protection, or support.

notes:
{翼|つばさ} refers to the wings of a bird, insect, or aircraft. It has a literary, elevated tone compared to the more everyday ⟦{羽|はね}→羽根：03696_hane⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {翼|つばさ}: wings (literary, poetic, often paired)
- ⟦{羽|はね}→羽根：03696_hane⟧: wing or feather (everyday, can refer to a single wing or feathers themselves)
{翼|つばさ} tends to evoke the image of wings spread in flight, while ⟦{羽|はね}→羽根：03696_hane⟧ is more general.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {翼|つばさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{広|ひろ}げる→広げる：01981_hirogeru⟧: to spread one's wings
- {翼|つばさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧: to have wings
- {翼|つばさ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{休|やす}める→休める：02437_yasumeru⟧: to rest one's wings

USAGE:
Often used metaphorically in expressions about ⟦{自由|じゆう}→自由：01148_jiyuu⟧, ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧, and ambition. Common in song lyrics, literature, and motivational contexts.

NAME:
{翼|つばさ} is also a popular given name for both boys and girls in Japan.
